title: Add a deterministic merge queue with signed strategies
author: w0F5vYijNonu8kkqLSa_jYY4GIV-Q5HpbxYY525ggm4

events.title: Add a deterministic merge queue with signed strategies
events.body:
## Outcome

Serialize ready pull requests into protected refs using signed merge, squash, or rebase strategies with exact-head revalidation.

## Implementation

- Define signed enqueue, reorder, pause, retry, cancel, and result events with deterministic concurrent ordering.
- Rebuild the candidate against the latest protected base and rerun required ownership, review, and workflow checks.
- Implement merge, squash, and rebase strategies with a signed resulting commit or attestation and explicit author or committer mapping.
- Update the protected ref atomically only if the base, head, policy, and check set still match.
- Pause conflicts with a browser and command-line resolution path that creates a new patchset rather than mutating history.

## Acceptance criteria

- Concurrent enqueue events produce the same queue order on every node.
- Stale base, head, approval, check, policy, or identity state prevents the ref update.
- Every strategy produces the expected tree and a verifiable signed result.
- One failed item does not discard or reorder unrelated queued work.
- A conflict cannot be bypassed without a reviewed replacement patchset or authorized signed override.

## Dependencies

Depends on #437, #454, #468, #470, and #471.

## Verification

Run concurrent enqueue, all strategies, base movement, head rewrite, stale checks, revoked reviewer, policy update, conflict and resolution, cancellation, retry, override, crash recovery, and atomic-ref fixtures.
